decision: Suitable as a descriptive offline geometry probe only. No product mask, skin/closure classifier, lash detection or Length adoption justified. LENGTH HOLD.
scope: Read frozen protocol and math/input/prepare helpers. No new source labels, detector results, overlays, browser or inference read/run for this review. Pure synthetic mathematical sanity checks were run in memory. Frozen protocol/labels/product untouched.
strengths: Native source-pixel eye axis and closest-segment/polygon distances avoid fixed320 image assumptions.
Both engines/frozen geometries and all predeclared aperture/depth combinations retained; rotated derivative identified rather than independent source.
Geometry/image/module hashes and annotation exposure limitations explicitly recorded.
No semantic skin assertion, manual seed/direction, runtime guard bypass or effect rendering.
No_face annotations remain excluded from geometric target matching; sparse labels are not exhaustive recall groundtruth.

limitations.issue: Aperture is an absolute projected difference of arc positions sampled at equal landmark-index fractions .25/.5/.75, divided by corner width.
limitations.implication: Not minimum opening, arc-length matching, semantic eyelid closure or validated closed-eye decision. Absolute value can conceal reversed/crossed arcs. Report the profile and descriptive cutoff results without choosing a favorable closure threshold.

limitations.issue: Uncertainty enlarges polygon-clearance requirement only. belowProbe.contains tests the center against axial interval, depth and sign.
limitations.implication: Do not describe containment as uncertainty-safe or proof the full positional uncertainty disk belongs to probe. Label-center membership and boundary sensitivity must be distinguished.
limitations.counterexample: 100px horizontal axis, upper y0/lower y1, center(11,20), uncertainty5: contains=true at depth.25/.5 and outside-polygon clearance passes, yet uncertainty disk includes x6 outside allowed axial lower bound10.

limitations.issue: Outward normal is chosen from lower-lid centroid; predicted arcs can nearly coincide in closed poses.
limitations.implication: Normal polarity can become numerically fragile; absence of an invalidity flag does not certify geometry. Predicted opening polygon is not semantic iris/sclera/skin segmentation.

limitations.issue: The so-called slab is nearest-upper Euclidean-distance band with normal sign plus global axial crop, not a rectangular strip or semantic skin mask.
limitations.implication: Depth.25/.5 times width can include large skin/fold/foreign-hair neighborhoods. Near polyline vertices, closest segment and sign can switch. Probe area or label inclusion is not precision, ownership, safety or rendering permission.

limitations.issue: Inputs are previously observed cases with sequential supplemental selection, only five ready provisional upper-ending labels and one rotated derivative.
limitations.implication: Results can expose domain exclusions but cannot quantify generalization, subgroup performance, false-positive rate or causal explanation for all rejected traces. Do not count C/W geometries or rotated derivative as independent real photos.

analyticSanityChecks.rigidTransform: Rotation.731rad plus translation(23,-17) preserves membership in a simple curved-eye fixture; axial error5.55e-17, signed and polygon distance error7.11e-15.
analyticSanityChecks.uncertaintyCounterexample: Center-only containment caveat reproduced without file/browser output.
analyticSanityChecks.meaning: Pure math checks validate limited implementation behavior, not real-image semantic correctness or natural Length.

overlayReviewRequirements: Display native source context with upper/lower arcs, predicted opening, probe boundaries/clearance and signed annotation locations; legends must call regions geometric probes.
Keep both eyes/engines, open/closed/hair/white-liner and rotated control visible, including unfavorable memberships.
Show uncertainty at label centers and note center-only probe membership near axial/depth boundaries.
Report all frozen aperture cutoffs and both depths; do not select cutoff because it includes these labels or excludes negatives.
Existing crossing paths are image evidence, not automatically foreign hairs. No target inclusion should approve Length or relax mandatory negative gates.
nextDecision: Inspect overlays and geometry-validity/center-membership tables before proposing any closure-aware domain. If domain admits negative texture/hair or protected regions, keep it diagnostic; no renderer/guard change.
